mx.Name: [GoalHunt] - Second Contribution
mx.Comments:
Hey all, it's been a while
After many months making this track, it's finally done, my second track for the Pursuit title pack is here.

I've had some issues during creation, one of them was trying to get the embed size under 1MB and I somehow managed to do it, but the other issue is the copper weight, I tried to optimize it as much as I could but it's still 11.5k, which is not great :( (Also experienced game crashes while computing shadows).

By far the worst issue is the blocks/items I needed, some were downloaded from IX and edited by myself in the Mesh Modeler to optimize them while others were made magnetic. I asked for permission to both authors' blocks/items I edited but got no response for 1 and a half weeks, proper credit will still be given anyway:

[align=center][item]From [user]72[/user]'s block set [url="https://item.exchange/set/view/11193"]StadiumCircuitCanyonImports[/url].
- Original unedited blocks are [url=https://item.exchange/item/view/57167]StadiumCircuitHalfBase[/url] and [url=https://item.exchange/item/view/57172]StadiumCircuitSimpleHalfBaseCornerIn[/url].
[item]From [user]20713[/user]'s item set [url="https://item.exchange/set/view/10498"]StadiumCircuitBorder additions[/url].
- Original unedited items are [url=https://item.exchange/item/view/25200]StadiumCircuitBorderCornerSlopeUp_ll
[/url] and [url=https://item.exchange/item/view/25196]StadiumCircuitBorderCornerSlopeDown_ll[/url].
These modified blocks/items [b]will not[/b] be uploaded to IX.[/align]
I really hope you enjoy :)

[i][u]07/05/2025 Update: A custom block from the title pack disappeared when loaded for some players, replaced evey instance of the block with vanilla blocks, a clip remover and an item[/u][/i]

mx.Name: [Pursuit] - First Contribution
mx.Comments:
Hey [mx]
Around 3 weeks ago I started on a project to create my first track for the Pursuit game mode, and here it is
I had some issues with with the lighting, items randomly dissapearing and even the pillars of most blocks that I had to remove
Don't have much to say other than this track has multiple ways you can go [i](There's also a secret area you can get into)[/i]
I also made 2 custom block variants using the Mesh Modeler, one of them took me a lot of time to finish but I'm happy with the result

Anyway, I hope you enjoy :)

[i][u]02/12/2024 Update: Included TrafficCar, updated thumbnail and some other very small fixes[/u][/i]

mx.Name: [Pursuit] - Third Contribution
mx.Comments:
Hey all
When I make a new track for Pursuit I always try a new style I've never done before, and I've chosen [i]Tower RPG[/i] for this one
This took around a week to finish, but I've had the idea for months because I couldn't think of something that worked, but I still like the end result
The difficulty should go from easy jumps to hard jumps depending on height, it might be off but again, it's my first time building an RPG

Anyway, hope you enjoy climbing (or falling) :)

[i][u]24/07/2025 Update: Removed the MT trigger for the intro sequence since it wasn't needed (also fixed the Camera Custom with it), added cam 3 change on the quarterpipe and changed the base vehicle to TrafficCar[/u][/i]

[i][u]03/09/2025 Update: Changed the item at the top to actually act as Race Objective, it was set to Checkpoint before[/u][/i]

mx.Name: MESA PROSPEKT
mx.Comments:
[i][b]PURSUIT MAP ONLY!!! WORKS ONLY WITH GALAXY MULTIENV!!! 
(also how add to TM2 Pursuit schedule?)[/b][/i]

In 2031, US government approved a construction of a massive research structure somewhere in canyons. It's location is classified and it's existence is hidden from wide public, but it's purpose known to the few is "simple" - the researching the fabric of universe. This top secret project in isolation has been given codename: 

[quote]MESA PROSPEKT[/quote]

This megastructure is weaved through-out with large piping circulating thousands of hectolitres of cooling fluids to the core, as well as being air-cooled by massive heat exchangers. Even though it's a massive strain on resources and the already grim economic stability, not only it's a way to find out about the dimension we inhabit, but it could also be a way to escape our decaying prison and become transcendant...

I've made this map for pursuit mod in TM2.
Uses Canyon as base.
Usable cars:

-Canyon car
-Valley Car
-Stadium Car
-Lagoon Car

Hope you'll enjoy :) (if that's even possible in today's economy...)
